content:
The right-side angles satisfy  
\[
55^\circ+35^\circ=90^\circ,
\]
so the upper vertical radius is perpendicular to the diameter \(AB\). Hence the angle between \(OA\) and the vertical radius is \(90^\circ\).

The shaded sector lies between \(OA\) and the diagonal radius that is \(40^\circ\) from the vertical, so its central angle is
\[
90^\circ-40^\circ=50^\circ.
\]
For a uniform point in the disk, probability is proportional to central angle:
\[
\frac{\text{area of shaded sector}}{\text{area of disk}}
=\frac{50^\circ}{360^\circ}
=\frac{5}{36}.
\]

\[
\boxed{\frac{5}{36}}
\]
